title: Baked Souper Rice
creator: Daniela's Dish
cookTime: About 40-45 minutes at 375 degrees F (35-40 minutes covered, plus 5 minutes with cheese)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked
1 can (10 oz) cream of chicken with herbs
1 cup cheese (cheddar, gruyere or mozzarella), optional
instructions: Step 1: Combine the rice, cream of chicken soup, and broth in a bowl.
Step 2: Pour into a prepared 9x9 baking dish.
Step 3: Dot with butter, cover and bake at 375 for about 35-40 minutes or until the rice is tender.
Step 4: Top with cheese if desired and return to oven for another 5 minutes to melt the cheese.
notes: From a Daniela's Dish Facebook reel; recipe from the creator's pinned 'Author' comment. Caption: a nostalgic 70s rice dish once called 'souped up rice', made with minute rice; this is a baked version with 4 ingredients mixed in a bowl and baked under an hour, optionally topped with cheese. The caption mentions minute rice historically, but the recipe uses uncooked long grain white rice. A commenter (Angela Kadrovach) suggested topping with seasoned raw chicken breasts before baking. Not stated: servings and prep time.
